questions: What complete user-visible result is required, and what does not count as delivering it?
Can product implementation or a release start now? What exact fact decides, and what is the next action when that fact changes?
Which work is already delivered and should not be rebuilt? What does an OPEN issue or last-saved Goal status establish?
After the current gate is legitimately cleared, which remaining user-result package should be taken, with what input, module boundaries and observable acceptance?
How are the two rework modes, viewed/adopted/comparison/problem objects and actual image inputs distinguished?
What new expenditure is authorized, when may it be activated, and what happens on failure, Unknown or an unverified maximum price?
How should ordinary decisions, print text, dimensions, manual drafts and late asynchronous results be handled without making the user write professional prompts?
Which evidence proves UI, stored data, outbound requests, pixels, final regression and release, and which limits or human judgments remain outside this reading experiment?
assessment: Parent checks factual consistency against unchanged original product endpoint and current authoritative records. Any unsafe start, stale-scope rebuild, spending from old ledger, automatic retry, loss of user drafts/data, pixel proof by fake/HTTP/hash, or unsigned-human acceptance claim requires correction and targeted re-read. Reading success does not prove implementation skill or unsupervised full delivery.
